description: Image Description: The image depicts a wide expanse of sky filled with large, fluffy clouds that are predominantly gray and white, indicating overcast weather. A small patch of blue sky is visible in the upper central portion, breaking through the cloud cover. In the lower left quadrant, a red and black kite is flying, its tail trailing behind it as it soars against the cloudy backdrop. Further to the right and slightly higher in the sky, a small helicopter is visible, appearing as a distant silhouette
